vulnerable_code:
class ClinicalTrialRecordViewSet(viewsets.ModelViewSet):
    queryset = ClinicalTrialRecord.objects.all()
    serializer_class = ClinicalTrialRecordSerializer
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated, DjangoObjectPermissions]
diagnosis: The viewset relies on DRF's DjangoObjectPermissions with an unscoped ClinicalTrialRecord.objects.all() queryset. By design in DRF, DjangoObjectPermissions has an empty permission map for safe methods (GET, HEAD, OPTIONS), meaning object-level read permissions are never checked by django-guardian. Any authenticated user can enumerate and read all confidential clinical trial records.
